zh: 修复设置页「外观 → 配色」的颜色卡只能选中自定义卡的问题：Claude 与 DeepSeek 卡现在也能点选，各自换上该卡的配色而不改动通用页的品牌标志，选中的卡上给出「恢复跟随品牌」，把配色交回当前品牌（#128）。
en: Fix the colour cards under Appearance → Colours accepting only the custom card: the Claude and DeepSeek cards can now be picked too, each painting its own palette while the theme style's brand mark stays, and a picked card offers “Follow the brand again” to hand the colours back (#128).
